continuity: Jin Taekyung killed Jamukha; Jamukha’s ambition to rule the steppe and north, and his feigned loyalty to Murong Baek, are now resolved by his death.
Jin Taekyung leveled up after defeating Jamukha; the System announced substantial EXP and Fame gains.
The North Heaven Demon Lord is retreating toward the gorge exit after Jamukha’s death. A huge arrow of light is flying toward him; its source and outcome are unknown.
The conditions of Jin Mukyung, Cheol Mubaek, Wipeng, and Peng Cheolhu remain unknown.
The Emperor remains gravely ill with Blood Soul Gu; the treatment said to require him to die once remains unresolved.
plot: Jamukha attacks Jeok Cheongang, but Taekyung intercepts him, tears away his braided hair, and overwhelms him with Flame Divine Palm strikes while Fire Dragon Armor withstands Jamukha’s blade. Jamukha dies, and Taekyung levels up. The North Heaven Demon Lord retreats toward the gorge exit and attacks the trapped Shanxi fighters, but a huge arrow of light strikes toward him before his attack lands.
translation_decisions: Keep “Shifting Form and Position,” “Flame Divine Palm,” and “Fire Dragon Armor” as established terms.

active_continuity: The Bow Saint has left the gorge to aid the Hebei Peng Family, where roughly two thousand fighters remain and pill-enhanced Keshiks have broken their formation.
Jin Taekyung killed Jamukha and leveled up after the System awarded him substantial EXP and Fame.
The North Heaven Demon Lord is retreating toward the gorge exit; a huge arrow of light is flying toward him, but its source and outcome are unknown.
The conditions of Jin Mukyung, Cheol Mubaek, Wipeng, and Peng Cheolhu remain unknown.
The Emperor remains gravely ill with Blood Soul Gu; the treatment said to require him to die once remains unresolved.
open_questions: Who sent the huge arrow of light toward the North Heaven Demon Lord, and what happens to him?
What are the conditions of Jin Mukyung, Cheol Mubaek, Wipeng, and Peng Cheolhu?
Can the Hebei Peng Family withstand the pill-enhanced Keshiks?
Can the Emperor be treated for Blood Soul Gu, and what does the treatment requiring him to die once entail?

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Jamukha is the ruler of the western steppe and a former eastern-steppe chieftain recruited into Dark Heaven by Murong Baek.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Jamukha was the ruler of the western steppe and a former eastern-steppe chieftain recruited into Dark Heaven by Murong Baek; Jin Taekyung killed him.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Patient and driven by a long-standing desire to avenge his defeat by Peng Cheolhu.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** Patient and ambitious, he was willing to feign loyalty to gain the power to rule the steppe and north.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Peng Cheolhu defeated him more than fifty years ago; Murong Baek spared him, recruited him into Dark Heaven, and commands him as a subordinate.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Peng Cheolhu defeated him more than fifty years ago; Murong Baek spared and recruited him, but Jamukha’s loyalty to him was feigned.
